abstract: Mature cystic teratomas of the ovary (MCT) are usually observed in women of reproductive age with the most dreadful complication being malignant transformation which occurs in approximately 1% to 3% of MCTs. In this case report, we present a patient with squamous cell carcinoma which developed from a MCT during pregnancy. The patient was treated conservatively without adjuvant chemotherapy and was followed without evidence of disease for more than 60 months using conventional tools as well as positron emission tomography-computed tomography following the initial surgery. We report this case along with the review of literature.
abstract_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)は通常、生殖年齢の女性にみられる。最も懸念される合併症は悪性転化であり、MCTの約1〜3%に生じる。症例報告: 本稿では、妊娠中に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が発生した症例を報告する。本症例は保存的に治療され、補助化学療法は行わなかった。初回手術後、従来の検査法および陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)-コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を用いて60か月以上にわたり無病の経過を確認している。文献レビューとともに本症例を報告する。
